title: Brand pack
description: Per-client brand context consumed by the campaign engine. This is machine-facing: authored and enriched by the /halfborg-campaign:setup-brand command, not hand-written by users. A minimal pack is valid on purpose (graceful degradation): only the brand skeleton is required, and the more that is filled in, the fewer questions intake has to ask. Extra keys are tolerated. Author as YAML (brands/<id>/pack.yaml) and validate the parsed object against this schema.

version.description: Optional pack schema version, e.g. "1". Written by the tooling; assume the latest when absent.

brand.description: The irreducible skeleton. This is the one part a user can give in a sentence.

id.description: Slug matching the brands/<id>/ folder. Lowercase and hyphens preferred; other characters tolerated and normalised on read.

positioning.description: One line: what the brand is, for whom, and why it is different.

url.description: Site URL. Scheme optional; normalised on read.

logo.description: Optional. The brand's logo as a real file under the brand folder, written by /halfborg-campaign:setup-brand when it reads the brand's website, and only after the downloaded bytes were verified to be an image. Consumed by build-landing-page, which embeds it in the page rather than linking it. Never passed to an image or video render: the engine's generated visuals stay text-free and logo-free. Absent means no usable logo was found, never that the brand has none.

path.description: Path relative to the brand folder, e.g. "assets/logo.svg". SVG preferred; PNG, WEBP and JPEG acceptable. Never an .ico: a favicon is not a brand asset.

dark_path.description: Optional. A variant for dark backgrounds, recorded only when the site actually serves a second file. Never derived or invented.

kind.description: Optional. wordmark = the brand name set as type; mark = the symbol alone; lockup = both together.

source_url.description: Where the file was downloaded from.

confirmed.description: false when lifted from a website and not yet eyeballed by a human. A consumer may use an unconfirmed logo, but should mention once that it came off the site.

market.description: Optional but recommended. Any sub-field may be omitted; intake asks for whatever is missing.

currency.description: ISO currency, e.g. "SGD". Case-insensitive; normalised to uppercase on read.

audience.description: Optional. Zero, one, or many segments. If absent, intake asks who the campaign is for. If present, intake asks only which of these a campaign targets.

voice.description: Optional. Satisfiable EITHER by a reference to existing voice skills OR by a prose summary. A brand-new user with no skills provides a summary; an established setup references skills. At least one is needed only if the voice key is present at all.

skills.description: Names of the generic voice skills deliverable expanders invoke, e.g. ["write-personal-post", "write-customer-story"]. Each skill reads this brand's delta from brands/<id>/voice-profiles.md.

summary.description: One-paragraph description of the voice, for brands without dedicated voice skills.

products.description: Optional. If absent, intake asks what the campaign promotes. If present, intake picks from this list.

photo.description: Optional. Path to a real photograph of this product, relative to the brand folder (e.g. "assets/serum-bottle.jpg"). Used as an identity reference image by prepare-reference-kit and generate-video whenever a rendered hero object must match the live SKU. Absent is fine and common; a skill that needs it and does not find it asks the user for the photo rather than synthesising the product.

buying_mode.description: Buying behaviour, read by the ads pipeline. "considered" (the default when absent) means nobody buys on impulse: the full Reach/Trust/Sell funnel applies. "acute" means high-intent cold traffic can convert in a single ad, qualifying the product for an additional direct-response concept tested against the warm-only Sell ad.

channels.description: Optional. If present, intake selects from these and the choice seeds the deliverable manifest.

ads.description: Optional. Present only for brands that run paid ads; read by write-ad-creative and write-video-ad-script, ignored by every other phase. SAFETY-RELEVANT: if this block is present, `presenter` is required, because the ads pipeline treats it as the confirmed answer to who may appear in an ad. A brand with no `ads` block is not ads-ready, and write-ad-creative routes to /halfborg-campaign:setup-brand rather than guessing.

presenter.description: Who fronts an ad. "product-led": no named person. "founder-voice-only": the founder's real voice carries first-person lines but they are never filmed. "founder-on-camera": the founder appears as a filmed person. Must be answered by a human; never inferred.

voice_rationing.description: How much of the brand's output uses the founder's first-person voice, and where. Only meaningful when voice.skills names a first-person voice skill. Absent means the engine default: first-person only for experiential claims, weighted top-of-funnel.

angle_bank.description: Raw material for Reach variants. The ads pipeline permutes one trigger moment against one framing to generate each variant. Extend from real customer language over time.

trigger_moments.description: The recurring problem, desire, or occasion moments that bring a customer to the brand. Audience insight to inform the hook's feeling, not a literal visual to depict.

framings.description: The emotional stance a hook takes toward a trigger moment.

mandatories.description: Non-negotiable legal / regulatory / brand-safety rules every deliverable must obey. Optional in the schema so a thin pack still validates, but SAFETY-RELEVANT: absence means 'unconfirmed', not 'none'. The /halfborg-campaign:setup-brand command always writes this key (even as []), and intake and QA must confirm compliance rather than assuming there are none.
